name: Yato
source: A mysterious young man who, for his own reasons, is committed to killing the Kogori afflicting the abandoned isle of Haikyo. What he lacks in social graces, he makes up for in his skill as a swordsman and naturalist. He and Mimei have a contentious relationship from the moment they first meet.
